recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to CDS Hooks response mapping details or profile ownership should be made in the CDS Hooks Clinical Reasoning IG or under a new CDS work group issue, not by restoring the old table in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-18241 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS work group request to clarify that a CDS Hooks Response maps 1:1 to a RequestGroup, Cards map to root actions, Suggestions map to nested actions, suggestion resources map to nested action resources, and selection behavior should be specified.
initial_application: Jira records GH#:20fd62db2d, and commit 20fd62db2d557dd133bd32041d93ba3f4edbd62b explicitly applied GF#18241 by adding CDS Hooks Response/Card/Suggestion/Action object and element mapping tables to source/clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html.
additional_context: Current core still builds the Clinical Decision Support page, but FHIR-24619 renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration and later Applied/Persuasive CDS issues FHIR-53085 and FHIR-48393 moved detailed CDS-on-FHIR content, CDS Hooks profiles, and mapping concept maps out of core into the dedicated CDS Hooks Clinical Reasoning IG. Current core is now an informative overview that links to that IG, whose source contains the equivalent response-to-RequestOrchestration mapping.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the detailed STU3 mapping table to core would duplicate and conflict with the later migration to the IG; current core correctly points implementers to the maintained detailed guidance.
